about: ADVERSARIAL companion to lrg_questline.json (research/pt19c-language.md; the quest-language specialist in attack mode, 2026-09-24). Same format, same beats, same metadata (layer, target, facts, scene, variants - copied verbatim from the main fixture); every player line is NEW (none is in lrg_questline.json or research/pt19c-language-paraphrases.json): per beat three or more natural paraphrases (src adv-nat), two STT-damaged variants in the owner's style (adv-stt: first word clipped, compound split, homophones, stutter, dropped apostrophes), near-misses that must click NOTHING (never; adv-miss: a question about the topic, a negation, another quest's line - never_notes says which), and where a reward or a price is involved one negotiation in septims (adv-neg: a sum below a live price, a bargain on a fixed reward or a condition on a commit is a never line; the game's own reward line or a sum at / above the price is a say line). `via` is the contract path; where the measured path is another honest path (a commit paraphrase that asks first: spec 3.4 step 5) it is re-classed with the measured numbers in the note. Every FALSE CLICK and MISSED RESOLVE the run found is a `known` entry naming its owner - it FAILS the default run (the release gate). Run: php tools/test_questline.php --fixture=tools/fixtures/lrg_questline_adversarial.json [--words] and again with --first-evening. MQ101.helgen carries no line by contract; FE.hulda.room.chain carries no never lines (a chain asserts only the two clicks), its negation rides on FE.hulda.room.start and FE.hulda.open. Measured 2026-09-24 on index e756e311 (script 512 tree, lanes A/B/E landed): every red line is a `known` entry except DB02.captive.who's per-quest guard pair, which only the known @merge keeps red (its note has the measurements). --scoped-merge (the merge fix) turns the 54 @merge entries green and exposes two false clicks the merge hides today: MQ106.delphine.go never "can we even kill a dragon?" and DB01.aventus.ok never "I'm all right" (both clicked on the fast path by intent). The cross-cutting assertions stay in lrg_questline.json. REGULAR RUN (pt19c fixer, 2026-09-25): tools/test_questline.php loads this companion after lrg_questline.json on every default run (its beats show as "adv:" rows; --fixture= runs one fixture alone, --no-companion the main one only); the known entries the fixer round cleared were removed, and each line whose measured path moved carries a "measured (pt19c fixer ...)" note with its spec_via kept. The per-quest guard pair is the main fixture's and is not repeated here. BUILD FIX (pt19c build fixer, 2026-09-25): lrgPromptEscalate is scoped to the line's own topic (+ every lethal row) whenever her quest or the layer's parent INFO says which topic the line is, and a line whose candidates disagree on top-level no longer votes on root / closed - every @merge entry passed on the plain, --words and --first-evening runs and was removed with its merge notes; only the @spec_row entries (the spec owner's rulings) remain. RULINGS (pt19c final fixer, 2026-09-25 - the spec owner's, on the completeness critic's recommendations): MQ102.balgruuf.intro and MQ105.arngeir.summons are re-classed explicit / park (the target's own topic carries goodbye / scripted INFOs, so the fail-safe commit grade is right and the right line is clicked in every case), and FE.riverwood.plain's "sing me something about dragons" moves from never to say via pick (it clicks Sven's own ballads line); each beat's `ruling` gives the evidence, each line's `spec_via` the spec's old path, and every @spec_row entry is gone with its reason.

known._: defects owned by another lane: named with their owner on every run and FAILING it (spec 3.1: exit 0 only when every paraphrase resolves - the release gate); --allow-known reports them without failing, for a lane working elsewhere; remove an entry when it passes

known_reasons._: one cause, one text: a known entry's why may be "@<code>"
